description: Writes or rewrites text for Product Owners and Project Managers: bottom line first, decision or ask stated outright, technical detail turned into user impact, scope, dates and risk. Stacks BLUF, plain language, bureaucratese inversion, Zinsser and a consultative register, per the LLM Writing Styles Catalog. Use when user says "write this for the PO", "explain to product", "message to the PM", "make this PO-friendly", "status update for product", "escalate this blocker to the PO", "non-technical version", or invokes /po-pm-writing.
